title: Near-optimal estimates for the $\ell^p$-Lipschitz constants of deep random ReLU neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2506.19695v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper studies the $\ell^p$-Lipschitz constants of ReLU neural networks $\Phi: \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}$ with random parameters for $p \in [1,\infty]$. The distribution of the weights follows a variant of the He initialization. In the case of zero-bias networks, we derive high probability upper and lower bounds for wide networks that differ at most by a factor that is logarithmic in the network's depth. Remarkably, the behavior of the $\ell^p$-Lipschitz constant varies significantly between the regimes $ p \in [1,2) $ and $ p \in [2,\infty] $. For $p \in [2,\infty]$, the $\ell^p$-Lipschitz constant behaves similarly to $\Vert g\Vert_{p'}$, where $g \in \mathbb{R}^d$ is a $d$-dimensional standard Gaussian vector and $1/p + 1/p' = 1$. translated_title: 深度随机ReLU神经网络的 $\ell^p$-Lipschitz 常数的近最优估计
translated_abstract: 本文研究了具有随机参数的ReLU神经网络 $\Phi: \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}$ 在 $p \in [1,\infty]$ 范围内的 $\ell^p$-Lipschitz 常数。权重的分布遵循He初始化的一个变体。在零偏置网络的情况下，我们为宽网络推导出了高概率意义下的上下界，这两个界之间最多相差一个与网络深度呈对数关系的因子。值得注意的是，$\ell^p$-Lipschitz 常数的行为在 $p \in [1,2)$ 和 $p \in [2,\infty]$ 两个区间之间表现出显著差异。对于 $p \in [2,\infty]$，$\ell^p$-Lipschitz 常数的表现类似于 $\Vert g\Vert_{p'}$，其中 $g \in \mathbb{R}^d$ 是一个 $d$ 维标准高斯向量，且 $1/p + 1/p' = 1$。相反，对于 $p \in [1,2)$，$\ell^p$-Lipschitz 常数更接近于 $\Vert g \Vert_{2}$。我们将分析进一步扩展到偏置可能非零且从任意分布中抽取的网络。
tldr: 本文证明了遵循He初始化变体的随机ReLU神经网络的 $\ell^p$-Lipschitz 常数的近最优估计，揭示了该常数在 $p \in [2,\infty]$ 时类似于高斯向量的 $\ell^{p'}$ 范数，而在 $p \in [1,2)$ 时则更接近高斯向量的 $\ell^2$ 范数。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes near-optimal estimates for the $\ell^p$-Lipschitz constants of random ReLU neural networks with a variant of He initialization, revealing that the constant behaves like the $\ell^{p'}$-norm of a Gaussian vector for $p \in [2,\infty]$, but aligns more closely with the $\ell^2$-norm for $p \in [1,2)$.
